description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'I18NDao' for managing internationalization (i18n) language data and translation messages within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve language information by language code and fetch translation messages associated with a specific language.

classes.name: I18NDao
classes.description: DAO class for accessing and manipulating internationalization language data and translation messages. Extends the core base DAO class to provide specific methods for language and translation retrieval.

methods.name: getLanguageByLangCode
methods.description: Retrieves an I18NLanguage entity matching the provided language code if it is enabled.

methods.name: getAllTranslationMessagesByLangCode
methods.description: Fetches all translation messages associated with a specified language code, including source value, target translation, and group name.

methods.name: createQueryBuilderWrapperForAllTranslationByLangCode
methods.description: Constructs a QueryBuilderWrapper for querying translation messages by language code, throwing an exception if the language code is invalid.
